purpose: Test whether the already-selected C1R compact Ross2011 steady-face representation can represent the unchanged C2B physical closure over the same homogeneous unsaturated 10-cm face envelope without increasing memory, runtime complexity or relaxing flux-error criteria.

candidate.interpolation: bilinear log mobility in binary64 arithmetic
candidate.state_to_coordinate: C2B direct S-to-u R1 mapping with exact endpoints and exact h=-4.2 cm retention join

reference_oracle.equation: Independent steady one-dimensional Darcy path solve used by C1R, with K(h) replaced only by the frozen C2B closure.
reference_oracle.seam_rule: Adaptive path and hydrostatic-mobility quadrature must split whenever an interval crosses a C2B conductivity-derivative seam.

selection_rationale.B10: legacy KSATEXM ratio 80 and prior broad wet-end representation failure
selection_rationale.O12: legacy KSATEXM ratio 80 and prior high near-saturation slope stress
selection_rationale.O13: legacy KSATEXM ratio 80, low-n stress and prior largest C2A R3 failure
selection_rationale.B05: wide wet extension interval and prior tail-localized failure
selection_rationale.O14: low KSATEXM ratio but previous interpolation and coordinate stress
selection_rationale.O05: well-documented near-saturation stiffness case from prior SWAP431 work
selection_rationale.B12: heavy-clay/low-n material, 80x KSATEXM and strongest legacy H_ENPR+KSATEXM discontinuity diagnostic

probe_policy.base: reuse C1R characterization ordinary Sobol, equal-head, hydrostatic, near-hydrostatic, wet-dry-cross and edge families with a fresh C2B material seed
probe_policy.additional_join_probes: add deterministic state pairs around h=-40 cm and h=-4 cm, including same-side and crossing cases with offsets 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.1, 0.5 and 2 cm where inside the frozen envelope

important_scaling_guard: Errors remain normalized to KSATFIT exactly as in C1R and C2A. The larger KSATEXM endpoint is not used to make the acceptance threshold easier.

exit_rule.characterization_pass: Freeze the N241 C2B representation unchanged and create a fresh 36-material C2B holdout before any catalog qualification claim.
exit_rule.characterization_fail: Reject this representation fail-closed. Any density, coordinate, interpolation or physical-closure change requires a new predeclared characterization contract before holdout access.

science_guard: Even a face-table pass does not empirically validate the new hydraulic closure. The KSATFIT->Ko and LEXP->L mapping remains subject to a separate soil-hydraulic science qualification.
scope_guard: Face response only. No h>-1 cm, saturation switching, transient timestep, heterogeneous face, explicit macropore, bottom boundary, groundwater, response tangent, MultiSWAP production or FullRichards equivalence claim.
